lines: Need a breather? Pause the ride, or end it.
While the ride runs, the app bar shows the clock, Pause and End.
Press Pause, and a Paused badge appears.
The clock holds at seven oh seven, and the bike stays at its level.
Press Resume, and the ride picks up from the same second.
Press End, and Wattzup asks first: End this ride?
Keep riding has the focus, so a stray tap changes nothing.
End ride reads Ending while the server stops the workout.
The ride is over, but your power trace and totals stay on the dashboard until you start a new ride.
On a phone, the same dialog, the same choice.
What the tests prove: resume continues from the same point.
And a paused ride is never shut off while the bike stays connected.
That is journey seven. Wattzup turns an Echelon bike or treadmill into a live training display.
